_note: Researched return weeks for rostered players. return_week = first NFL week the player is expected to play. Maintained by the morning report run. NFL IR = minimum 4 games.

A.J. Brown.note: On IR, high-ankle sprain. Week 6 (vs NYJ) was the earliest eligible date, but Rapoport (9/22): 'the expectation is he misses six weeks' - Patriots determined the injury is more serious than the initial 4-6 wk range suggested. Realistic return is Week 8 vs MIA.

Jordan Mason.note: IR (fractured thumb, surgery), placed 9/16 so must miss Weeks 2-5; Vikings are on bye Week 6, so Week 7 is the earliest game. O'Connell expects him back at the short-term IR minimum. Aaron Jones is Minnesota's lead back - Mason projects as backup/change-of-pace once healthy.
Jordan Mason.source: NBC Sports, NFL.com, Kevin O'Connell, Ian Rapoport

Isiah Pacheco.note: Back surgery to remove a body pressing on a nerve; 12-week recovery with a chance he's back early December (Rapoport). Replaces the old IR-minimum Week 5 estimate. Not currently rostered in this league.
Isiah Pacheco.source: Ian Rapoport (NFL Network), ESPN, Pro Football Rumors

Zach Charbonnet.note: Reserve/PUP (ACL). Macdonald: not activated for Week 6 TNF at DEN. Must be activated by 10/22 (21-day window); Week 7 vs KC (10/25) is next.

Jordyn Tyson.note: IR (designated to return), right hamstring strain. Schefter (10/5): making progress but won't be activated before Week 7 at the soonest; Saints bye is Week 8, so Week 9 vs CLE is the more likely debut. Moore said he would not practice this week. Week 7 remains possible.
Jordyn Tyson.source: Adam Schefter (ESPN) via The Fantasy Footballers, Kellen Moore via NBC Sports

Josh Jacobs.note: Pleaded no contest Sept 10 (criminal case resolved). Remains on Commissioner's Exempt List (paid, can't play/practice); NFL confirms no timetable for discipline. Standard domestic-violence-case suspension is 6 games, could be shorter or longer.

De'Von Achane.note: Torn ACL in Week 3 loss to KC, confirmed by MRI Monday; placed on IR. Out for the season.

Caleb Williams.note: Grade 2 hamstring (Week 2). Practiced fully all of Week 6; officially questionable but expected to play at ATL. Delete once he plays.

Travis Etienne.note: Placed on IR with the Week 3 hamstring injury; must miss at least four games. Earliest return is Week 9 vs CLE (Nov 8) - Saints bye is Week 8.
Travis Etienne.source: RotoBaller, NBC Sports (PFT), Saints injury report

Christian Kirk.note: Still on IR (calf). Shanahan said 10/2 the 49ers could open his practice window in two weeks, so Week 5 and almost certainly Week 6 are out; Week 7 is the realistic earliest game. SF byes Week 8, so a slow ramp means Week 9.
Christian Kirk.source: Kyle Shanahan via Matt Barrows (The Athletic), relayed by ESPN/RotoWire

Breece Hall.note: Quad. Jets Friday report lists him out for Week 6 vs NE (third straight miss). Still week-to-week, no IR.
Breece Hall.source: Jets Friday injury report via Yahoo/FantasyPros (10/16)

Ja'Kobi Lane.note: Short-term IR (fractured wrist, surgery) after Week 1. Eligible to return Week 6.

Jonah Coleman.note: IR 9/26 with a high-ankle sprain suffered Week 2. Must miss at least 4 games; Week 7 vs ARI is the earliest return.

Lamar Jackson.note: Left ankle sprain (Week 4). Hasn't practiced in two weeks; Minter ruled him out Friday 10/16 for Week 6 at CLE (second straight miss). Huntley starts. Week 7 unconfirmed.
Lamar Jackson.source: Jesse Minter via Yahoo Sports/Baltimore Beatdown (10/16)

Saquon Barkley.note: Hamstring (Week 4). Missed all week of practice; officially out Week 6 vs CAR. Week 7 unconfirmed.
Saquon Barkley.source: NBC Sports Philadelphia, Yahoo injury table (10/16)

DeVonta Smith.note: Hamstring; hasn't practiced since Week 3. Ruled out Week 4 and now Week 5 vs JAX (London). No IR. Week 6 is the earliest.
DeVonta Smith.source: CBS Sports Week 5 injury report (10/9), NBC Sports Philadelphia

Jadarian Price.note: Placed on IR 10/3 after aggravating a chest injury (first hurt Week 2) in practice. Must miss at least 4 games (Weeks 4-7); Week 8 is the earliest.
Jadarian Price.source: Seahawks via NBC Sports (PFT), FOX 13 Seattle, TSN

Stefon Diggs.note: Hamstring; did not practice all week and is officially Out for Week 5 vs NYG. No timeline reported - Week 6 is unconfirmed.
Stefon Diggs.source: Commanders.com game status, ESPN Fantasy inactives column

Kyle Monangai.note: Out Week 5 at GB (thumb/toe). Jeremy Fowler: dealing with turf toe and could miss another week or two. Week 7 is a midpoint estimate, unconfirmed. D'Andre Swift keeps the lead role.
Kyle Monangai.source: Jeremy Fowler (ESPN) via ESPN Fantasy inactives column, Sleeper status

Caleb Douglas.note: Ankle, hurt Week 2; missed Weeks 3-4, did not practice Wed/Thu of Week 5 and shown as Out on Sleeper (third straight miss). Hafley has called him day-to-day; official Week 5 designation not confirmed in what I could read. Dolphins bye is Week 6, so Week 7 is the next game - unconfirmed.
Caleb Douglas.source: Jeff Hafley via RotoBaller, Sleeper status (10/11)

Marvin Harrison.note: Not injured: held out Week 5 while a trade was finalized. Traded to Houston 10/11 (confirmed by DeMeco Ryans; Schefter/Rapoport: 2027 2nd + 6th for Harrison and a 7th). Week 6 is his first possible game as a Texan; delete this entry once he plays.
Marvin Harrison.source: DeMeco Ryans via AP, Adam Schefter (ESPN), Ian Rapoport (NFL Network)

TreVeyon Henderson.note: Right high-ankle sprain, hurt Week 5 vs LV; MRI Monday 10/12. Schefter: expected to miss multiple weeks, no surgery, not reported on IR. No firm timeline - Week 9 (three missed games) is a midpoint estimate, unconfirmed. Rhamondre Stevenson leads the backfield meanwhile.
TreVeyon Henderson.source: Adam Schefter (ESPN) via RotoWire, Pats Pulpit

Deebo Samuel.note: Right hamstring strain, hurt Week 5 vs SEA. Shanahan: strained it 'pretty good', will miss 'at least a couple weeks'; MRI confirmed a multi-week absence. Out Week 6 vs WAS and Week 7 at ATL; 49ers bye is Week 8, so Week 9 is the earliest realistic return.

Jalen Hurts.note: Superficial blood clot in calf (cleated Week 4 vs LAR). Follow-up ultrasound Wed 10/14 showed the clot moving; ruled out Week 6 vs CAR, no timetable. Tanner McKee starts. Yahoo's Week 6 tracker headline says he's going on IR (couldn't read the detail, unconfirmed); IR = Weeks 6-9 minimum, so Week 10 is the earliest if that holds.
Jalen Hurts.source: Eagles statement via ESPN/Philadelphia Inquirer (10/15); Yahoo Sports injury tracker headline (unconfirmed IR)

David Montgomery.note: Groin, left Week 5 vs TEN. DeMeco Ryans: week-to-week. Out for Week 6 vs JAX in London. Week 7 unconfirmed - one analysis calls a Week 7 miss more likely than not. Woody Marks leads the backfield.
David Montgomery.source: DeMeco Ryans via RotoBaller/Fantasy Footballers; RotoWire (10/15)
